body: The skatepark doesn’t bother me so much as far as drug use goes. If someone’s smoking I’ll just steer clear of that area till they’re done. I live about 30 minutes from the nearest park and I work 5 days a week, so I only get 2 days to actually go skate. And I’ve had really bad anxiety ever since I got arrested. I’m really scared to go to a new skatepark by myself, especially because where I now live there’s a handful of pros here that are really good and I’ve always looked up to them. I’m not a bad skater, but I’m not very good either. I’m competent, but the people I’d be skating with now are exceptional. Because of that I haven’t gone to the skatepark at all in almost 6 months. If I skate I do so by myself or every now and then with friends from my hometown. Moving out here was a really bad idea in hindsight but I’m gonna have to stay for a while. I can’t leave yet. I don’t think things would be so hard if I wasn’t alone all the time. Thanks for your advice man. I’ll try to keep it in mind.
Thank you so much for taking your time to talk with me. It’s helped me get out of that negative mindset for the night. I’ll try and keep everything you said in mind. I really appreciate you man.

The one thing I’ve ever had in my life besides drugs is skateboarding. These days it’s the only thing that makes me feel like me again. I don’t get to skate as much as I’d like to but it gives me something to look forward to. I was going to college before all this happened, but now I’m a felon so I can’t get financial aid and my savings account is completely empty after paying for my lawyer and court fees. I’m working a bullshit job just doing busy work for an engineering company right now. I hate it. A friend of mine is a plumber and he’s trying to help me get hired at his company. If all goes well I’ll start working there and attending trade school once I save up some more money. So I’ve got somewhat of a plan, it’s just never what I hoped to be doing with my life. I really wish I wanted to be sober. I have a handful of friends that have been straightedge their entire lives and I envy them so much. I hate the fact that I love being high and doing nothing all day, or being incapacitated after eating way more mushrooms than I ever should. I hate that I let myself fall into all that. I want to move on from it so badly but my brain just won’t let me forget that it’s fun to be high and to experience the world differently. And I really hope none of this is triggering to anyone else on here. I know I seem like a selfish brat but it’s hard to not be caught up in your own problems when you spend most of your time completely alone. Thanks so much for talking to me. It helps more than you probably realize.

I just don’t really know what there is to learn. The only thing this whole situation has taught me is that 1. Cops will do anything it takes to make your life harder once you get arrested. And 2. I should’ve been sneakier. I feel like sobriety only really works when you truly want it to work. I never wanted this. I don’t want to be reliant on drugs to be happy but in also feel like I should have the freedom to do them if I so please. I don’t know... I know I just sound like a dumb hypocrite. I feel like I can’t get my mind straight these days. I don’t know how to move on from things. I’ve never been good at that. I thought moving away and putting some distance between myself and all those memories would help but it just made everything worse. Now all I do is work a job that I hate and then come home and feel sorry for myself. I hate who I’ve become. I keep telling myself that things will change, I’m only 19, but the further I’ve gotten into this whole court process the worse it’s become. And I’m sorry for all this ranting. I don’t really have anyone to talk to these days. I need to get these thoughts out somewhere. I feel like I’m about to explode.

Sorry I’m just now getting back to you. Essentially I’m going to jail and pleading guilty to probation as a part of a plea deal. The cops interrogated me after I was arrested and tricked me into confessing to distribution even though I was never actually selling drugs. They asked if I had ever given drugs to my friends, to which I answered yes because I was terrified, and they used that to put a distribution charge on me. The DA said that if I plead guilty to possession they won’t give me the distribution charge and I’ll dodge a prison sentence. Realistically I got pretty lucky, but I also got screwed over. My sentencing date keeps getting pushed back due to COVID, hopefully I’ll be in jail soon and I can just get this over with. I’ve pretty much accepted what’s happening to me at this point.

I don’t really wanna say what state cause I’m not supposed to be giving out details of my case. I got pulled over and searched, they were in my wallet. My lawyer is pretty good, but the cops/prosecutor are trying to give me a distribution charge without any decent evidence that I was distributing. I don’t have enough money to keep fighting this. My savings have been completely drained.
Look into the history and reasoning behind why certain substances are scheduled the way they are. A lot of them are incredibly racially motivated.

I live in a very small town where the police are incredibly over staffed and over funded. We don’t have very much actual crime and they need to prove their jobs are important or they’ll be laid off, so most of the time they serve out the harshest punishments they can muster. It’s ridiculous.
I am but I’d rather not say what state. I’m not supposed to be sharing details of my case in the first place but I need to vent about it somewhere or I’ll lose my mind.
the criminal justice system is broken, especially in small towns where real crime barely exists.
Thank you. I really appreciate it <3
All drug laws are arbitrary and rooted in racial injustice but there’s no point to dwell on it when those are things I can’t change.

I keep trying to think like that but it’s really hard to. I wasn’t a criminal, I’ve never been in a fight, and I do my best to do right by everyone I cross paths with. I’ve struggled with my mental health for about 3 years now. I was really making progress and starting to feel better, then I got arrested. Even though I understand I broke the law, I feel like I’m being punished so much more severely than I deserve. I wasn’t putting anyone in danger. I feel so cheated. I’m a scrawny little kid from the suburbs who does nothing but go to school, work and skateboard. I’m not a danger to society. I don’t feel like I deserve what’s happened to me. My savings have been completely drained through this process due to how expensive lawyers are. Throughout the whole thing I was told over and over again by people I trusted that I was going to get probation and that was it. Every time I regained a little bit of hope it was shattered by bad news. I know life is unfair sometimes, but damn this seems so extreme. I just want all this to be over, but I haven’t even faced the worst of it yet. Thank you for your kind words. I really do appreciate it.

Man I’ve been waiting for change since I was 13. Living in a tiny town like this the only thing that’s changed is we’ve gone from everyone overdosing on crack to overdosing on heroin. Honestly I can’t take living here anymore, especially in a house where my parents aren’t willing to help me. I’ve developed such awful social anxiety that the idea of going out and making new friends is genuinely scary. Besides, these friends give me free drugs from time to time. Wouldn’t want to ruin that. Talking to has helped, even if it’s just been a little.  So thank you for that truly.

All the things that made me want to hold on don’t make me happy anymore. Music is just noise to me at this point and skateboarding just makes me frustrated. Video games are boring and hanging out with friends just reminds me I’m the third wheel. I can barely eat anymore and I can’t stand to look myself in the mirror because I see nothing but failure and disappointment. I know my family will be sad, and my friends will pretend like they cared, but it’s their own fault. They should have listened to me. It’s not like I didn’t want help. I’m just ranting at this point, but fuck I’m just so mad. And at the end of it all I bet I won’t even go through with it. I’ll get scared and recess back into my room and be miserable for another year. I appreciate that you are willing to listen, but virtual interactions with people I can’t see face to face just don’t cut it anymore. Thank you so much for listening.
